MR Safety
The Zephyr Cochlear Implant is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 3 Tesla only when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Scan in First Level Controlled Operating Mode.
- Head Transmit/Receive Coil ONLY.
- Receive with the head transmit/receive coil.
- WB-SAR ≤ 1.5 W/kg.
- Maximum Head SAR 0.4 W/kg.
Before scanning, set the device configuration: Therapy OFF.
Scan regions: Extremity scanning only (knee and below, elbow and below).
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
